"''I have no record of that system.''"
"''Because the best treasures usually aren't found on maps.|Phee Genoa and [[Tech]]|}} The '''Kaldar Trinary system''' was situated in [[the galaxy]]. It contained the [[planet]] [[Skara Nal]] where an ancient [[Skara Nal Mech|walker]] was buried and also contained at least one [[moon]]. The [[Trinary star|trinary]] [[star system]]'s coordinates were engraved on a [[Omega's Compass|compass]] which led its owners to the ancient war machine. By [[18 BBY]],{{TBBDate|205}} no [[star map]] featured the location of the system. Between [[19 BBY]] and 18 BBY, [[Phee Genoa]], members of [[Clone Force 99]] and [[power droid]] [[MEL]]-221 traveled to the system in search for "treasure" after finding the system coordinates in a compass found at an [[unidentified junkyard]] on the [[planet]] [[Ord Mantell]]. ==Behind the scenes== The location first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]'' [[The Bad Batch Season 2|Season 2]] episode "[[Entombed]]," released on [[January 25]], [[2023]].{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-bad-batch-season-2-trailer-key-art|text=Clone Force 99 Is Back in New ''Star Wars: The Bad Batch'' Season 2 Trailer}} ==Appearances== *{{TBB|Entombed}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=news/keith-kellogg-bad-batch-interview|text=Riot Racing, Droidekas, and Crosshair's Sneer: ''Star Wars: The Bad Batch'' Animation Director Keith Kellogg Talks Season 2 So Far}} *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' *''[[Star Wars: Complete Locations, New Edition]]'' *{{TheStarWarsGalaxy}} *{{GalaxyMapAppendix}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Sistema Trinario Kaldar |ja=カルダー三連星系 |ka=კალდარის სამმაგი სისტემა }} [[Category:Chopani sector locations]] [[Category:Star systems in the New Territories]] [[Category:Star systems in the Outer Rim Territories]] [[Category:Trinary star systems]]
